collection_policy.source_rule: Open confirmed official_schedule_url only. Never substitute an aggregator URL when an official URL is missing or blocked.
collection_policy.missing_url_behavior: Keep the cinema row in the run report with needs_official_schedule_url; do not silently skip or mark it closed.
collection_policy.blocked_behavior: Record runner-side HTTP status, stop additional requests to the blocked host for the run, retain canonical last-known-good data, and apply cooldown.
collection_policy.parser_rule: Only adapters marked as implemented may write normalized screening rows; generic page probes report access and schedule markers without fabricating rows.
